digest.component_or_area: contributor documentation — git workflow and close procedure
propositions: Contributors must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge, before closing a ticket, by running git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main

The rebar close precheck verifies that the merged rebar-ticket: commit is reachable from HEAD of the active repo; if the shared main checkout is touched instead of the contributor's worktree, uncommitted operator WIP may be clobbered

Documentation in AGENTS.md (close-discipline bullet, lines 156-157) and CONTRIBUTING.md (new §2f subsection, lines 181-190) must carry post-merge fast-forward guidance and warn against touching the shared main checkout
The fix is documentation-only; no code changes to src/rebar are required because the git log mechanism in transition_close.py is correct — only the contributor guidance was missing
